title: XOPT v1.0.2: Research Artifact — Code, Data, and Experiments
description: Correction release of XOPT 1.0.1. Preserves all 2668 original attempts and their original computational code; adds an explicitly bound correction of one UC false-optimality result, fully bound current radius calculations and fresh numerical witness checks, corrected validators, enumeration deadlines and allowlisted computational packaging. Version 1.0.1 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23472314) remains available as the original archive. Original code is MIT; public data retain their own licenses. Editable manuscript sources are excluded.
